name: Minecraft Bedrock
author: contact@pixelcst.tech
description: Offizieller Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server (Linux) mit Mojang-Standardwerten. Laedt die Version direkt von Mojang, unterstuetzt latest/preview/feste Versionen, schreibt Chat und Tode in die Konsole und behaelt beim Update Welten und Einstellungen.
startup: if [ -f server.properties ]; then P={{SERVER_PORT}}; U="$P"; IP="{{PUBLIC_IP}}"; if [ -z "$IP" ] || [ "$IP" = "auto" ]; then IP=""; case "{{SERVER_IP}}" in ""|0.0.0.0|127.*|10.*|192.168.*|172.1[6-9].*|172.2[0-9].*|172.3[0-1].*) ;; *) IP="{{SERVER_IP}}";; esac; if [ -z "$IP" ]; then IP=$(curl -4 -fsS -m 5 https://api.ipify.org || curl -4 -fsS -m 5 https://ifconfig.me || true); fi; fi; if [ "$IP" = "off" ]; then IP=""; fi; if [ -n "$IP" ]; then U="$IP:$P:$P"; echo "NetherNet: oeffentliche Adresse $IP:$P"; fi; for KV in "server-portv6=$((P+1))" "server-udp-ports=$U" "emit-server-telemetry={{TELEMETRY}}"; do K="${KV%%=*}"; sed -i "/^$K=/d" server.properties; echo "$KV" >> server.properties; done; fi; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. ./bedrock_server

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft Bedrock Dedicated Server - Installations-/Update-Skript fuer Pterodactyl
# Laeuft im Installer-Container (ghcr.io/parkervcp/installers:debian) unter /mnt/server

set -e

SERVER_DIR="${SERVER_DIR:-/mnt/server}"
UA="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36"
API_URL="https://net-secondary.web.minecraft-services.net/api/v1.0/download/links"

if ! command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update -y && apt-get install -y curl jq unzip ca-certificates
fi

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}"
cd "${SERVER_DIR}"

VERSION="${BEDROCK_VERSION:-latest}"
VERSION="$(echo "${VERSION}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | xargs)"
[ -z "${VERSION}" ] && VERSION="latest"

get_api_link() {
    curl -fsSL -m 30 -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" -H "Accept: application/json" "${API_URL}" \
        | jq -r --arg t "$1" '.result.links[] | select(.downloadType==$t) | .downloadUrl' 2>/dev/null | head -n1
}

get_page_link() {
    curl -fsSL -m 30 -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" -H "Accept-Language: en-US,en;q=0.9" \
        "https://www.minecraft.net/en-us/download/server/bedrock" \
        | grep -oE "https://[^\"']*/$1/bedrock-server-[0-9.]+\.zip" | head -n1
}

DOWNLOAD_URL=""
case "${VERSION}" in
    latest)
        echo ">> Suche aktuelle Bedrock-Version ..."
        DOWNLOAD_URL="$(get_api_link serverBedrockLinux || true)"
        [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] && DOWNLOAD_URL="$(get_page_link bin-linux || true)"
        ;;
    preview)
        echo ">> Suche aktuelle Bedrock-Preview-Version ..."
        DOWNLOAD_URL="$(get_api_link serverBedrockPreviewLinux || true)"
        [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] && DOWNLOAD_URL="$(get_page_link bin-linux-preview || true)"
        ;;
    *)
        if ! echo "${VERSION}" | grep -qE '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){2,3}$'; then
            echo "!! Ungueltige Version '${VERSION}'. Erlaubt: latest, preview oder z.B. 1.21.50.10"
            exit 1
        fi
        DOWNLOAD_URL="https://www.minecraft.net/bedrockdedicatedserver/bin-linux/bedrock-server-${VERSION}.zip"
        ;;
esac

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "!! Konnte keinen Download-Link ermitteln. Bitte spaeter erneut versuchen oder eine feste Version angeben."
    exit 1
fi

echo ">> Download: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
rm -f bedrock-server.zip
if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -m 600 -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" -o bedrock-server.zip "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
    echo "!! Download fehlgeschlagen (Version vorhanden?)."
    exit 1
fi
unzip -tq bedrock-server.zip >/dev/null || { echo "!! Heruntergeladene Datei ist kein gueltiges ZIP."; exit 1; }

# Bei Updates eigene Konfiguration behalten
BACKUP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"
for f in server.properties permissions.json allowlist.json whitelist.json; do
    if [ -f "$f" ]; then cp -a "$f" "${BACKUP_DIR}/"; fi
done

echo ">> Entpacke Server ..."
unzip -oq bedrock-server.zip
rm -f bedrock-server.zip

# Neue Standard-server.properties merken, um fehlende Eintraege zu ergaenzen
cp -a server.properties "${BACKUP_DIR}/server.properties.new"

for f in server.properties permissions.json allowlist.json whitelist.json; do
    if [ -f "${BACKUP_DIR}/$f" ]; then cp -af "${BACKUP_DIR}/$f" "./$f"; fi
done

# Alle Eintraege, die in der behaltenen server.properties fehlen, aus der neuen Version uebernehmen
ADDED=0
while IFS= read -r line || [ -n "$line" ]; do
    case "$line" in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
    key="${line%%=*}"
    if ! grep -q "^${key}=" server.properties; then
        echo "$line" >> server.properties
        ADDED=$((ADDED+1))
    fi
done < "${BACKUP_DIR}/server.properties.new"
[ "${ADDED}" -gt 0 ] && echo ">> ${ADDED} fehlende Eintraege in server.properties ergaenzt"
rm -rf "${BACKUP_DIR}"

# Server-Telemetrie standardmaessig aktivieren
TELEMETRY="${TELEMETRY:-true}"
if grep -q "^emit-server-telemetry=" server.properties; then
    sed -i "s/^emit-server-telemetry=.*/emit-server-telemetry=${TELEMETRY}/" server.properties
else
    echo "emit-server-telemetry=${TELEMETRY}" >> server.properties
fi

chmod +x bedrock_server

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Grundeinstellungen fuer neue Welten (werden beim Start zusaetzlich vom Panel gesetzt)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
set_prop() {
    grep -v "^$1=" server.properties > server.properties.tmp || true
    echo "$1=$2" >> server.properties.tmp
    mv server.properties.tmp server.properties
}
[ -n "${LEVEL_NAME}" ] && set_prop level-name "${LEVEL_NAME}"
[ -n "${LEVEL_SEED}" ] && set_prop level-seed "${LEVEL_SEED}"
[ -n "${GAMEMODE}" ] && set_prop gamemode "${GAMEMODE}"
[ -n "${DIFFICULTY}" ] && set_prop difficulty "${DIFFICULTY}"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Chat-Log: Behavior-Pack, das Chatnachrichten und Tode in die Konsole schreibt
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PACK_UUID="5d1e7c3a-8b2f-4c6d-9e0a-1b2c3d4e5f60"
PACK_DIR="behavior_packs/konsolen_chatlog"
LEVEL="$(grep '^level-name=' server.properties | cut -d= -f2-)"
[ -z "${LEVEL}" ] && LEVEL="Bedrock level"
WORLD_DIR="worlds/${LEVEL}"

run_probe() {
    rm -f "$1"
    (
        for _ in $(seq 1 150); do
            sleep 1
            if grep -qE "Server started|Exiting program" "$1" 2>/dev/null; then break; fi
        done
        sleep 2
        if [ -n "$2" ]; then echo "$2"; sleep 3; fi
        echo stop
    ) | LD_LIBRARY_PATH=. timeout 200 ./bedrock_server > "$1" 2>&1 || true
}

update_world_packs() {
    # $1 = add | remove
    python3 - "$WORLD_DIR/world_behavior_packs.json" "$PACK_UUID" "$1" <<'PY'
import json, os, sys
path, uuid, mode = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
packs = []
if os.path.exists(path):
    try:
        packs = json.load(open(path))
    except Exception:
        packs = []
packs = [p for p in packs if p.get("pack_id") != uuid]
if mode == "add":
    packs.append({"pack_id": uuid, "version": [1, 0, 0]})
if packs or os.path.exists(path):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    json.dump(packs, open(path, "w"), indent=2)
PY
}

write_pack() {
    # $1 = @minecraft/server Version
    mkdir -p "${PACK_DIR}/scripts"
    cat > "${PACK_DIR}/manifest.json" <<JSON
{
  "format_version": 2,
  "header": {
    "name": "Konsolen-Chatlog",
    "description": "Schreibt Chatnachrichten und Tode in die Server-Konsole",
    "uuid": "${PACK_UUID}",
    "version": [1, 0, 0],
    "min_engine_version": [1, 21, 0]
  },
  "modules": [
    {
      "type": "script",
      "language": "javascript",
      "uuid": "9c4b2a1d-6e5f-4a3b-8c7d-0e1f2a3b4c5d",
      "version": [1, 0, 0],
      "entry": "scripts/main.js"
    }
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    { "module_name": "@minecraft/server", "version": "$1" }
  ]
}
JSON
    cat > "${PACK_DIR}/scripts/main.js" <<'JS'
import { world } from "@minecraft/server";

world.afterEvents.chatSend.subscribe((ev) => {
    console.log(`[Chat] <${ev.sender.name}> ${ev.message}`);
});

world.afterEvents.entityDie.subscribe((ev) => {
    const dead = ev.deadEntity;
    if (dead.typeId !== "minecraft:player") return;
    const src = ev.damageSource;
    let by = src.cause;
    if (src.damagingEntity) {
        by = src.damagingEntity.typeId === "minecraft:player"
            ? src.damagingEntity.name
            : src.damagingEntity.typeId.replace("minecraft:", "");
    }
    console.log(`[Tod] ${dead.name} ist gestorben (${by})`);
});
JS
}

CHAT_LOG="${CHAT_LOG:-true}"
if [ "${CHAT_LOG}" = "true" ]; then
    echo ">> Richte Chat-Log ein ..."
    if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
    if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "!! python3 nicht verfuegbar - Chat-Log wird uebersprungen."
    else
        cat > /tmp/enable_beta_api.py <<'PY'
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Aktiviert das Experiment "Beta APIs" (gametest) in einer Bedrock level.dat.
Benutzung: enable_beta_api.py <pfad/zur/level.dat>
Exit-Code 0 = gesetzt bzw. schon aktiv, 1 = Fehler."""
import shutil
import struct
import sys

END, BYTE, SHORT, INT, LONG, FLOAT, DOUBLE, BARR, STR, LIST, COMP, IARR, LARR = range(13)


class R:
    def __init__(self, b):
        self.b, self.i = b, 0

    def take(self, n):
        v = self.b[self.i:self.i + n]
        self.i += n
        return v

    def u(self, fmt):
        n = struct.calcsize(fmt)
        return struct.unpack("<" + fmt, self.take(n))[0]

    def s(self):
        return self.take(self.u("H")).decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")


def read_payload(r, t):
    if t == BYTE: return r.u("b")
    if t == SHORT: return r.u("h")
    if t == INT: return r.u("i")
    if t == LONG: return r.u("q")
    if t == FLOAT: return r.u("f")
    if t == DOUBLE: return r.u("d")
    if t == BARR: return r.take(r.u("i"))
    if t == STR: return r.s()
    if t == LIST:
        et, n = r.u("b"), r.u("i")
        return (et, [read_payload(r, et) for _ in range(n)])
    if t == COMP:
        d = []
        while True:
            ct = r.u("b")
            if ct == END:
                return d
            name = r.s()
            d.append([ct, name, read_payload(r, ct)])
    if t == IARR: n = r.u("i"); return list(struct.unpack("<%di" % n, r.take(4 * n)))
    if t == LARR: n = r.u("i"); return list(struct.unpack("<%dq" % n, r.take(8 * n)))
    raise ValueError("unbekannter Tag %d" % t)


def ws(s):
    b = s.encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape")
    return struct.pack("<H", len(b)) + b


def write_payload(t, v):
    if t == BYTE: return struct.pack("<b", v)
    if t == SHORT: return struct.pack("<h", v)
    if t == INT: return struct.pack("<i", v)
    if t == LONG: return struct.pack("<q", v)
    if t == FLOAT: return struct.pack("<f", v)
    if t == DOUBLE: return struct.pack("<d", v)
    if t == BARR: return struct.pack("<i", len(v)) + v
    if t == STR: return ws(v)
    if t == LIST:
        et, items = v
        return struct.pack("<bi", et, len(items)) + b"".join(write_payload(et, x) for x in items)
    if t == COMP:
        return b"".join(struct.pack("<b", ct) + ws(n) + write_payload(ct, p) for ct, n, p in v) + b"\x00"
    if t == IARR: return struct.pack("<i", len(v)) + struct.pack("<%di" % len(v), *v)
    if t == LARR: return struct.pack("<i", len(v)) + struct.pack("<%dq" % len(v), *v)
    raise ValueError(t)


def set_byte(comp, name, val):
    for e in comp:
        if e[1] == name:
            e[0], e[2] = BYTE, val
            return
    comp.append([BYTE, name, val])


def main(path):
    data = open(path, "rb").read()
    version = struct.unpack("<i", data[0:4])[0]
    r = R(data[8:])
    rt = r.u("b")
    rname = r.s()
    root = read_payload(r, rt)
    exp = next((e for e in root if e[1] == "experiments" and e[0] == COMP), None)
    if exp is None:
        exp = [COMP, "experiments", []]
        root.append(exp)
    if any(e[1] == "gametest" and e[2] == 1 for e in exp[2]):
        print("Beta APIs bereits aktiv")
        return 0
    set_byte(exp[2], "gametest", 1)
    set_byte(exp[2], "experiments_ever_used", 1)
    set_byte(exp[2], "saved_with_toggled_experiments", 1)
    body = struct.pack("<b", rt) + ws(rname) + write_payload(rt, root)
    shutil.copy2(path, path + ".bak")
    open(path, "wb").write(struct.pack("<ii", version, len(body)) + body)
    print("Beta APIs aktiviert")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1]))
    except Exception as ex:  # noqa
        print("Fehler beim Bearbeiten der level.dat:", ex)
        sys.exit(1)
PY
        set_prop content-log-console-output-enabled true
        if [ ! -f "${WORLD_DIR}/level.dat" ]; then
            echo ">> Erzeuge Welt '${LEVEL}' ..."
            run_probe /tmp/bds_probe1.log
        fi
        if [ -f "${WORLD_DIR}/level.dat" ] && python3 /tmp/enable_beta_api.py "${WORLD_DIR}/level.dat"; then
            write_pack "99.0.0-beta"
            update_world_packs add
            echo ">> Ermittle Script-API-Version ..."
            run_probe /tmp/bds_probe2.log
            API_VERSION="$(grep -oE 'Current \[beta\] version is \[[^]]+\]' /tmp/bds_probe2.log | head -n1 | sed -E 's/.*\[([^]]+)\]$/\1/')"
            if [ -n "${API_VERSION}" ]; then
                write_pack "${API_VERSION}"
                echo ">> Chat-Log aktiv (Script-API ${API_VERSION})"
            else
                echo "!! Script-API-Version nicht ermittelbar - Chat-Log deaktiviert."
                update_world_packs remove
                rm -rf "${PACK_DIR}"
            fi
        else
            echo "!! Welt konnte nicht vorbereitet werden - Chat-Log wird uebersprungen."
        fi
        rm -f /tmp/bds_probe1.log /tmp/bds_probe2.log /tmp/enable_beta_api.py
    fi
else
    update_world_packs remove 2>/dev/null || true
    rm -rf "${PACK_DIR}"
fi

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Server-Identitaet dauerhaft speichern, damit Spieler nicht bei jedem Neustart
# erneut gefragt werden, ob sie dem Server vertrauen
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if [ -f keys/server_identity_key.pem ]; then
    echo ">> Gespeicherte Server-Identitaet vorhanden (keys/server_identity_key.pem)"
else
    echo ">> Speichere Server-Identitaet ..."
    run_probe /tmp/bds_probe3.log "serveridentity save"
    if [ -f keys/server_identity_key.pem ]; then
        echo ">> Server-Identitaet gespeichert (keys/server_identity_key.pem)"
    else
        echo "!! Server-Identitaet konnte nicht gespeichert werden. Bitte einmal in der Konsole: serveridentity save"
    fi
    rm -f /tmp/bds_probe3.log
fi

echo "${DOWNLOAD_URL##*/}" | sed -e 's/^bedrock-server-//' -e 's/\.zip$//' > .bedrock_version

echo ">> Installation abgeschlossen: Version $(cat .bedrock_version)"

variables.name: Bedrock Version
variables.description: Welche Server-Version installiert wird: 'latest' (aktuelle Version), 'preview' (Vorschau) oder eine feste Version wie 1.21.50.10. Zum Updaten den Server neu installieren (Welten und Einstellungen bleiben erhalten).

variables.name: Servername
variables.description: Der Name, der in der Serverliste angezeigt wird.

variables.name: Schwierigkeit
variables.description: Schwierigkeit: peaceful, easy, normal oder hard.

variables.name: Welt-Seed
variables.description: Seed fuer neue Welten (leer = zufaellig). Gilt nur beim Erstellen einer neuen Welt.

variables.name: Online-Modus (Xbox-Login)
variables.description: Spieler muessen mit einem Xbox/Microsoft-Konto angemeldet sein (true/false).

variables.name: Allowlist (Whitelist)
variables.description: Nur Spieler auf der Allowlist duerfen beitreten (true/false). Spieler hinzufuegen in der Konsole mit: allowlist add <Name>

variables.name: Netzwerk-Transport
variables.description: nethernet = neuer Standard ab 1.26 (TCP + UDP auf dem Server-Port, funktioniert auch ohne IPv6). raknet = klassischer UDP-Modus (benoetigt IPv6 im Container, sonst stuerzt der Server ab).

variables.name: Oeffentliche IP
variables.description: Nur fuer nethernet: Die IP, ueber die Spieler den Server erreichen. 'auto' = automatisch (Allocation-IP, sonst oeffentliche IP des Hosts), eine feste IP eintragen (z.B. LAN-IP fuer Heimserver) oder 'off' zum Abschalten. Leer = auto.

variables.name: Server-Telemetrie
variables.description: Sendet anonyme Server-Telemetrie an Mojang (emit-server-telemetry, true/false).

variables.name: Sichtweite
variables.description: Maximale Sichtweite in Chunks (min. 6). Hoeher = mehr RAM/CPU.

variables.name: Tick-Distanz
variables.description: Wie viele Chunks um Spieler herum aktiv berechnet werden (4-12). Hoeher = mehr CPU.

variables.name: Maximale Threads
variables.description: Maximale Anzahl CPU-Threads des Servers (0 = so viele wie moeglich).

variables.name: Chat-Log in der Konsole
variables.description: Schreibt Chatnachrichten und Tode in die Konsole (true/false). Aktiviert dafuer in der Welt das Experiment 'Beta APIs'. Aenderung wird bei einer Neuinstallation wirksam.
